summary: SF_STAIR_RAILING_NC_v1 passes QA with 4 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 7 pipeline files present. Cross-file threading validated: 43 TSK_ IDs in sop_modules match 43 rates in production. All acceptance criteria from brief met. Canonical painting sequence (balusters → newels → handrails) enforced. Quad UOM (EA/EA/LF/LF) consistent across files. Iron substrate handling (SSPC-SP 1, DTM/bonding primer) correctly modeled. Tread protection mandatory and shared with SF_STAIR_RISER_NC.

rule_1_tsk_sop_to_production.details: All 43 TSK_STRL_* task IDs in sop_modules.json have matching entries in production.json.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.details: ITM_STAIR_BALUSTER, ITM_STAIR_NEWEL, ITM_STAIR_HANDRAIL, and ITM_STAIR_BASE_RAIL all appear in spec.json paintable_items and are covered by variants.

rule_3_sys_qt_match.details: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC→QT3, SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE→QT4, SYS_FF_PREMIUM→QT5 match spec.json configuration_dimensions. Primer systems correctly driven by railing_type + substrate_state.

rule_4_inputs_consumed.details: All IN_ inputs in spec.json are consumed by sop_modules tasks via paintscope_key references or production rate calculations.

rule_5_ps_keys_match.details: All 7 PS_ keys (4 proposed surface, 3 existing protection) match between spec.json required_paintscope_inputs and sop_modules/production.

rule_6_zones_match.details: 3 zone_ids (stair_tread_covers, floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent) match between spec.json and sop_modules protection_metadata.

rule_7_phase_order.details: Module sequence: setup → prep → prime → finish → interstage → finish → cleanup. Correct.

rule_8_uom_match.details: UOM consistent: baluster tasks=EA, newel tasks=EA, handrail tasks=LF, base rail tasks=LF, interstage/inspect/cleanup=FIXED in both sop_modules and production.

rule_9_tsk_prefix.details: All tasks use TSK_STRL_ prefix per resolution.json.

rule_10_itm_ids.details: All 4 ITM_ IDs are proposed (new), correctly marked in resolution and spec.

rule_11_enum_values.details: All enum values used across files match resolution.json applicable_enums. No prohibited values detected. CON_ prefix used (not CONS_). task_classification used (not task_class). Severity values correct. Phase values correct. All units uppercase.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state
EA counting for balusters (ITM_STAIR_BALUSTER) and newels (ITM_STAIR_NEWEL)
LF counting for handrails (ITM_STAIR_HANDRAIL) and base rails (ITM_STAIR_BASE_RAIL, conditional)
Treads excluded — routed to SF_STAIR_TREAD_NC
Risers/stringers excluded — routed to SF_STAIR_RISER_NC
Decorative shoes excluded — installation item, not painting scope
quality_tier minimum QT3 (QT2 not applicable per doctrine 10.1)
Sheen/QT gate enforced: satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only
railing_type (all_wood/iron_and_wood) present as config dimension
baluster_profile (square/turned) present as config dimension, affects production rates
substrate_state drives primer: SS_BARE, SS_PRIMED_FACTORY, SS_POWDER_COATED
Iron baluster solvent cleaning (SSPC-SP 1) mandatory when railing_type=iron_and_wood
DTM primer for iron balusters when railing_type=iron_and_wood + SS_BARE
Bonding primer for powder-coated iron when SS_POWDER_COATED
Wood primer per Millwork Doctrine when railing_type=all_wood + SS_BARE
QT-driven finish material system per Fine Finish Doctrine Section 3
Tread protection (stair_tread_covers zone) mandatory from setup to cleanup
Canonical sequence: balusters (#5) → newels (#6) → handrails (#7)
Handrail bracket removal included as conditional task (QT4+)
Newel-to-tread and newel-to-handrail caulk included as prep tasks
Module structure follows Fine Finish combined prime+paint pattern
Interstage between-coat cycle present at ALL quality tiers
Between-coat sanding discipline per tier: QT3=spot, QT4=full 220, QT5=full 220-320
Feel test on handrails at QT5 in final inspect
Optional poly topcoat on handrails at QT5
4 proposed PaintScope keys documented
4 proposed Surface IDs documented
Existing PaintScope keys verified against catalog
State declarations: input SS_BARE/SS_PRIMED_FACTORY/SS_POWDER_COATED, output SS_PAINTED
Spray containment techniques documented for spray application method

issues.description: Newel post production rates (4 EA/hr brush, 12 EA/hr spray) are estimates derived from baluster rates scaled by relative size (2-3x larger). No canonical doctrine provides per-EA newel painting rates.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rates are reasonable estimates. Refine after field testing.

issues.description: Handrail LF rates (65 LF/hr brush, 200 LF/hr spray) are estimated at 25% slower than flat trim rates due to 4-surface access. No canonical doctrine provides handrail-specific LF rates.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable estimate. Refine based on field data.

issues.description: Default QT3 + default semi-gloss creates tension — sheen/QT gate requires QT4+ for semi-gloss. Runtime enforcement will reject semi-gloss at QT3 and offer satin as alternative.
issues.suggested_fix: Acknowledged tension — same as riser and trim specs. Runtime gate handles correctly. Effective default: QT3+satin or QT4+semi-gloss.

issues.description: Baluster SF-per-unit estimates (square 1.5-2.0 SF, turned 2.0-3.0 SF) are geometric approximations. Actual surface area varies significantly by baluster size and ornament complexity.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for material quantity estimation. Wide ranges account for variability. Field calibration recommended.

doctrine_compliance.stairway_systems_doctrine: Compliant. Canonical sequence enforced (#5 balusters, #6 newels, #7 handrails). QT2 prohibited. Tread protection mandatory. SSPC-SP 1 for iron. DTM/bonding primers for iron. HVLP preferred for spray. Bracket removal at QT4+. Feel test at QT5. Optional poly topcoat.
doctrine_compliance.fine_finish_doctrine: Compliant. Combined prime+paint. Interstage at all QTs. Sanding discipline per tier. QT5 brush/roll 3+ coats. Primer is substrate-driven, finish is QT-driven.
doctrine_compliance.millwork_nc_paint_doctrine: Compliant. Wood primer systems per substrate (standard, tannin-blocking, stain-blocking).
doctrine_compliance.paintscope_stairwell_geometry_system: Compliant. Handrail LF derivable from rake_length. Baluster count estimable from riser count. Access modifier context documented.
doctrine_compliance.modifier_registry: Compliant. H1 for all railing components. QT modifiers on qt_scaled tasks. baluster_profile modifier (1.75x turned) documented with doctrine source. No prohibited modifier values.
doctrine_compliance.conventions: Compliant. CON_ prefix (not CONS_). task_classification (not task_class). Severity values correct (critical/major/minor). Phase values correct (setup/prep/prime/finish/interstage/cleanup). All units uppercase (EA/LF/SF/FIXED/ROLL/SHEET/QT/TUBE).

key_innovations: First spec with 4 paintable items (balusters EA, newels EA, handrails LF, base rails LF conditional)
First spec with iron/metal substrate handling (DTM primer, SSPC-SP 1, powder coat bonding)
First spec with SS_POWDER_COATED substrate state
First spec with railing_type config dimension driving primer chemistry (all_wood vs iron_and_wood)
First spec with baluster_profile config dimension driving production rates (square vs turned, 1.75x)
First spec with optional polyurethane topcoat (handrails at QT5)
First spec with feel test inspection (handrails at QT5)
First spec with tread protection VERIFY task (shared protection from prior spec)
